title: The Fools are Certain; the Wise are Doubtful: Exploring LLM Confidence in Code Completion
abstract: arXiv:2508.16131v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Code completion entails the task of providing missing tokens given a surrounding context. It can boost developer productivity and serve as a code discovery tool. Code completion has recently been approached with Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned on code (code LLMs). The performance of code LLMs can be assessed with downstream and intrinsic metrics. Downstream metrics are usually employed to evaluate the practical utility of a model, but can be unreliable and require complex calculations and domain-specific knowledge. In contrast, intrinsic metrics such as perplexity, entropy, and mutual information, which measure model confidence or uncertainty, are simple, versatile, and universal across LLMs and tasks, and have been proposed as proxies for functional correctness and hallucination risk in LLM-generated code. translated_title: 愚者笃信，智者存疑：探索大语言模型在代码补全中的置信度
translated_abstract: 代码补全涉及在给定上下文的情况下提供缺失令牌的任务。它可以提升开发者生产力，并作为一种代码发现工具。近年来，代码补全已通过针对代码进行微调的大型语言模型（代码LLM）来实现。代码LLM的性能可以通过下游指标和内在指标进行评估。下游指标通常用于评估模型的实用价值，但可能不可靠，且需要复杂的计算和领域特定知识。相比之下，内在指标如困惑度、熵和互信息，用于衡量模型置信度或不确定性，这些指标简单、通用，适用于各种LLM和任务，并被提议作为LLM生成代码的功能正确性和幻觉风险的代理指标。基于此，我们通过测量代码困惑度来评估LLM在生成代码时的置信度，涵盖多种代码补全场景。
tldr: 该论文通过内在指标（如困惑度）评估代码LLM在代码补全中的置信度，以替代不可靠的下游指标，并探索置信度与功能正确性及幻觉风险的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates the confidence of code LLMs in code completion using intrinsic metrics like perplexity, proposing them as proxies for functional correctness and hallucination risk, instead of unreliable downstream metrics.
